Title: Sr. Data Scientist
Description: Location: Mexico City, Mexico Function: (DEAI HV) Finance Requisition ID: R0141891 Our Company We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers - from banks to theme parks - can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate - and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team - and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data. In order to be considered, please submit your resume in English The Team Hitachi Vantara is looking for a Sr. Data Scientist to join its Global Analytics & Decision Sciences (GADS) team. Being a part of the Hitachi Vantara Finance Organization, this team connects the dots across multiple business functions to drive growth, enable data-driven decision-making, and solve complex business problems. In this role, you will collaborate with a broad range of internal stakeholders, including and not limited to services, sales, marketing, product management, finance, pricing, and partner operations, as well as key business owners and stakeholders across multiple levels and functions within the organization. You will work with diverse data sources to analyze business problems, translate insights into action, and support executive decision-making. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform computer-aided quantitative and statistical analysis using advanced tools and scientific modeling techniques in support of the organization’s global strategies. The candidate must demonstrate strong attention to detail and data quality, along with the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. The Role Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross functional teams to understand enterprise-wide analytical needs, frame key questions, translate requirements into actionable data and analytics solutions, and align objectives and measurable outcomes. Provide thought leadership in advanced analytics, including statistical analysis and descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive modeling, to solve complex business challenges and shape analytical strategy. Synthesize insights across multiple business dimensions, including financial performance, forecasts, products, geography, industries, competitive landscape, and customer segments, to drive data-driven decision-making and strategic direction. Design and develop scalable data and analytics solutions using programming languages (e.g., Python, SQL), data platforms (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle), cloud technologies (e.g., AWS), and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI). Apply advanced statistical and quantitative techniques, including high complexity predictive modeling, to develop data driven solutions and deliver actionable, fact-based insights. Evaluate and utilize current and emerging technologies to identify trends, enhance analytical capabilities, and deliver innovative solutions and recommendations. Lead cross functional projects and programs, communicating complex analytical findings through clear and concise presentations to management and executive audiences. Drive adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) by leading initiatives, establishing best practices, and scaling capabilities across the team. Mentor and develop junior team members in advanced analytics and data science practices and provide regular updates and insights to management. What You’ll Bring Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Quantitative Economics, Marketing Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; Master’s degree with relevant professional experience preferred. Minimum of 5+ years of experience as a Data Scientist or in a similar analytical, quantitative, or technical role. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. Proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience in data engineering, data wrangling, feature engineering, and scalable data processing. Experience with statistical analysis and machine learning techniques (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing, dimensionality reduction, predictive modeling, and data mining) to generate actionable business insights. Experience working with diverse data sources, data platforms, and reporting/analytics tools (e.g., SQL Server, Denodo or similar technologies). Experience with Cloud platforms, including storage, querying, and advanced analytics (AWS, GCP or Azure). Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with proficiency in tools such as Power BI and advanced Excel. Strong understanding of data modeling principles, ML libraries and best practices. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Demonstrated ability to explore and leverage new data sources, tools, and methodologies to improve analytical capabilities and business outcomes. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across diverse teams and stakeholders. Advanced English proficiency. About Us We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential. Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth. We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work. How We Look After You We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with. We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Title: Data Analytics - Regulatory Solutions
Description: About Nu Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page Regulatory Solutions Analytics at Nubank As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Latin America, Nubank has grown exponentially since its inception — and keeping that growth healthy and people-centered depends on making critical, data-informed decisions every day. Regulatory Solutions Analytics is at the heart of that process: our analysts work across teams to structure and analyze data, challenge assumptions, and translate findings into real improvements for our customers. You bring the depth, autonomy, and technical fluency to lead that work on the most demanding problems — and to raise the bar for the analysts around you. We’re looking for people who are curious, proactive, and energized by solving complex problems: not necessarily those with all the answers, but those who know how to find them. About The Role This role sits in Pack Analytics within Regulatory Solutions (Ops Defense). You’ll turn the analytical demands of our regulatory processes — KYC, AML, Judicial Orders, and others — into advanced analytics, models, and AI-powered solutions, while keeping the highest standard of quality for customer data and due diligence, in line with regulators and internal policies. You will operate with growing autonomy: you solve well-defined problems independently and take on harder, more ambiguous challenges with the support of your team and manager, beginning to build deep expertise in your domain. Above all, you are excellent with data and genuinely passionate about artificial intelligence, proactively keeping yourself at the frontier of what these tools can do. As a Sr Analyst in Regulatory Solutions Analytics, you’re expected to Lead investigative, data-first work end to end: decide which data makes the most sense in each situation and, when it isn’t there yet, design the right tests or approaches to generate it. Own advanced data analysis — run root-cause analysis, formulate and test hypotheses, and deliver effective solutions to challenging (though typically well-defined) problems with limited supervision. Apply data science and statistical methods (e.g., anomaly detection, classification, segmentation, forecasting) to strengthen, scale, and automate regulatory decisions. Use artificial intelligence as a core tool: leverage GenAI/LLMs and modern AI tooling to accelerate analysis, prototype solutions, and automate manual work — and proactively stay at the frontier of AI, bringing new techniques back to the team. Work with large volumes of data using SQL, Python, and Scala — writing optimized queries and code to build a solid foundation for decision-making, knowing that not all answers live in the data, and that’s okay. Build dashboards and visualizations (e.g., QuickSight, BigQuery) that go beyond the descriptive, surfacing trends, deviations, and forward-looking signals across historical and future horizons. Apply solid, practical knowledge of data architecture and modeling (Data Mart, Data Lake, Data Warehouse) for analytical purposes, and manage dataset dependencies. Understand our products and how they interact with other areas of the business, translating business, legal, and customer needs into quantitative metrics (KPIs, OKRs). Support data-based decisions across your team, making calculated risk-taking comfortable despite uncertainty while keeping project flow. Apply data governance fundamentals — data classification, secure access to PII, lineage, quality monitoring, and cost optimization. Learn continuously and share knowledge generously, beginning to act as a reference in your area. What We’re Looking For Strong analytical capacity: comfort with numbers and calculations, and the ability to solve problems methodically. Excellent with data — advanced data analysis and/or data science — with the appetite to go deep on large, ambiguous transactional datasets. Hands-on fluency with SQL and at least one general-purpose language (Python and/or Scala). A real passion for artificial intelligence and machine learning, with a proactive habit of keeping up to date and applying new tools to real problems. Business basics: understanding the dynamics between risks and opportunities, and how business and technical areas (product/engineering) interact. Problem solving: creativity and practicality in tackling day-to-day challenges, with awareness of how your work impacts our customers’ experience and aligns with our purpose. Proactive, autonomous, and curious — comfortable solving well-defined problems on your own and escalating the harder, ambiguous ones at the right time. Clear, succinct, and effective communication in English and Spanish. Openness to feedback and adaptability to a multifunctional, fast-changing environment. It will be a differential if you… Have data engineering experience — building and maintaining data pipelines, working with massive parallel processing (e.g., Spark / MPP), and using lineage and orchestration tools. (Data engineering is a strong plus.) Hold a degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or Physics) with a solid statistical modeling and analysis background. Have hands-on experience taking machine learning or AI / GenAI solutions to production. Are familiar with “Know Your Customer” and AML / regulatory topics, applicable not only for Mexico but also for Brazil and other Latin American countries. Location for this opportunity Mexico City, Mexico Benefits Health and life insurance Food card 15 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus Holiday Bonus (“Aguinaldo”) of 30 days of pay per year NuCare — our mental health and wellness assistance program NuLanguage — our language learning program Extended maternity and paternity leaves Equity at Nubank Work Model for this Role This role is based full-time, on-site, at our Mexico City office. Title: Sr. Growth & Performance Specialist | Paid Media, CRM & Automation
Description: Modalidad: Híbrida, 4 días en oficina y 1 día de home office Ubicación: Insurgentes Sur 1248, Col. Tlacoquemécatl del Valle, CDMX Tipo de contratación: Honorarios (requiere expedir factura) Compensación: $30,000 MXN base mensual + bono objetivo de $12,000 MXN mensuales por resultados, pagado trimestralmente ($36,000 por trimestre). Acelerador de hasta 150% del bono por desempeño sobresaliente. Fecha de inicio: Inmediato Sobre Spark225 Spark225 es una agencia boutique de marketing especializada en salud. Ayudamos a compañías farmacéuticas, médicos y clínicas a convertir su inversión en Health Conversion: acciones medibles que acercan a una persona a una mejor decisión de salud y al cliente a su objetivo de negocio. No vendemos campañas aisladas ni volumen de leads; construimos sistemas que conectan estrategia, paid media, landing, CRM, automatización y medición. El reto Buscamos a una persona que lidere con autonomía el sistema full funnel de las cuentas asignadas: estrategia, inversión en medios, landing, medición, CRM, automatización, seguimiento y resultados verificables. Su principal reto es proteger la retención de los clientes y traducir medios digitales en Health Conversion real, con un pipeline que avanza y no abandona oportunidades. No es un puesto de media buyer: discutirás la estrategia con el Founder como par y la ejecutarás con autonomía. Qué harás - Construir y mantener la estrategia full funnel documentada de cada cuenta. - Operar y optimizar Google Ads y Meta Ads: estructura, pacing, audiencias, pruebas y escalamiento. - Auditar y mejorar landing pages, formularios y flujos de WhatsApp. - Diseñar pipelines, workflows, alertas y agendamiento conversacional en GoHighLevel. - Implementar y validar la medición: GA4, GTM, Pixel/CAPI, Enhanced Conversions, UTMs y dashboards. - Liderar reuniones de resultados con clientes, con reportes que terminan en decisiones y un plan de retención por cuenta. - Documentar configuraciones, cambios, SOPs y aprendizajes. Cómo sabremos que lo lograste Te mediremos por resultados verificables, no por número de campañas o reportes: retención y crecimiento de las cuentas, Health Conversion real por cuenta, avance del pipeline, eficiencia de la inversión y datos confiables para decidir. Lo que buscamos - Mínimo 5 años en performance o growth, administrando inversión real y con resultados cuantificados. - Experiencia como dueño de la estrategia de cuentas de punta a punta, no solo ejecutor. - Evidencia de retención o crecimiento de clientes. - Dominio de Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, GTM, Pixel/CAPI y UTMs. - GoHighLevel o CRM equivalente. - Conocimiento práctico de CRO, dashboards, automatización, APIs/webhooks e IA aplicada con verificación. Suma mucho Experiencia con médicos, clínicas o pharma; inglés profesional; capacidad de discutir estrategia con dirección y convertir hipótesis en mejores resultados. Cómo trabajamos Nuestros tres valores: Life at the Center (cada decisión debe acercar a alguien a una mejor salud), Think Until It Clicks (pensamos hasta que datos, insight y creatividad conectan) y Close the Loop (avanzado no es cerrado). Ofrecemos retos reales, autonomía con objetivos claros y feedback basado en evidencia. No prometemos un entorno sin exigencia ni ascensos automáticos. Proceso Filtro inicial, entrevista técnica, caso práctico con defensa en vivo, entrevista de cultura y referencias. Para postularte, contesta las preguntas de la solicitud y comparte uno o dos casos donde hayas conectado campañas con resultados de negocio, sin datos confidenciales.
